name: mix-SQP
model_likelihood: Finite mixture with known component likelihoods; minimize -sum_j log(sum_k L_jk x_k)/n on the simplex
inference_algorithm: Equivalent nonnegative objective f(x)+sum_k x_k; SQP with backtracking, active-set quadratic subproblems and low-rank RRQR (or truncated SVD) derivatives
estimand: Maximum likelihood estimates of mixture proportions x
data_input: Nonnegative n by m component-likelihood matrix L
tunable_settings: Initial simplex weights; line-search sufficient decrease xi (default 0.01); backtracking factor rho (default 0.5); dual tolerance (default 1E-8); active-set tolerance (default 1E-10)
